THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCKADE.title: Rockade
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCKADE.descrip: At the end of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} Block for each Giant Rock played this combat.
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_FORM.title: Rock Form
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_FORM.descr: At the start of each turn, add a {IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock} to your hand. Rock cards cost 1 less.
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_ARMOR.desc: Whenever you play a Giant Rock, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_SLAM.title: Rock Slam
THROW_ROCK_IRONCLAD_CARD_ROCK_SLAM.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Add a Giant Rock to your discard pile. Exhaust.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-HIDDEN_ROCK.title: Hidden Rock
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-HIDDEN_ROCK.descriptio:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 card.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-INEVITABLE_ROCK.title: Inevitable Rock
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-INEVITABLE_ROCK.descri:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_FIVE.title: Rock Five
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_FIVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_CHARGE.title: Rock Charge
THROWROCKIRONCLAD-ROCK_CHARGE.descriptio:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold] to your hand.
